tldr: Mercury in Taurus: the mind is steady, practical, and grounded in what can be trusted.
body: With Mercury in Taurus, thinking is deliberate and words carry weight. You communicate best when ideas have time to settle into something useful and real.
gift: Reliability, practical judgment, memory, and a calm persuasive voice.
challenge: Stubborn opinions, slow adaptation, or refusing a new idea because the old one feels safer.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material. Owner waived ‘settle into’ as an idiomatic use under Batch 2 Decision A on 2026-08-04; body text remains unchanged.
